test_title: PYST 04: SSC MTS 2024 - Numerical and Mathematical Ability (Held On: 07 Oct, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: A car can cover 275 km in 5 hours. If its speed is reduced by 5 km/h, then how much time will the car take to cover a distance of 250 km?
solution:
**Given:**

Initial speed of the car = 275 km / 5 hr = 55 km/hr

Distance to be covered = 250 km

Reduced speed = 55 km/hr - 5 km/hr = 50 km/hr

**Formula Used:**

Time = Distance / Speed

**Calculation:**

Time taken to cover 250 km at 50 km/hr:

⇒ Time = 250 km / 50 km/hr

⇒ Time = 5 hr

**The car will take 5 hours to cover 250 km at a reduced speed of 50 km/hr.**
